title: Level Supremacy
paragraphs: The fiancé had been given some free time by the queen and was on their way to feed the Filolials at the Filolial stable when they happened to pass in front of the carriage where we were parked.
“Haha! Over here, over here!”
“Wait for me!”
“Hurry up and catch up!”

They saw Sakura-chan and the others playing and decided to call out to them. Of course. It is only natural that anyone who catches a glimpse of the pure, noble, and beautiful Filolials would be drawn to them.
“Wow… are you Filolials? You can talk!”
“Hmm? Who are you?”
With their skillful social finesse, the fiancé quickly became friends with Sakura-chan and the others. To befriend them instantly upon meeting… As expected of Filo-tan’s fiancé.
“Wait, wait!”

At first, they were just playing tag with Sakura-chan and the others, but since the area near the carriage was too small for proper play, Sakura-chan and the others decided to ask me for permission and move to the courtyard instead. During introductions, the fiancé mentioned their nickname, “Mel.” That’s why Kou started calling them “Meh” or other casual variations. After setting the courtyard as the play area, they decided to play hide-and-seek. Sakura-chan drew the lot to be “it,” and everyone went off to hide. Once Sakura-chan finished counting, she started wandering through the courtyard, which was like a maze, and soon found the fiancé hiding in the bushes.
“Found you, Mel-chan!”
“You got me!”
With a playful grin, the fiancé stepped out of the bushes. Clearly, they were going easy on Sakura-chan.
“Alright, next, I’ll look for Yuki and Kou!”
“Okay!”
Just as they were about to search for Yuki-chan and Kou—
“Oh my? Isn’t that Bouko over there?”

Hearing the voice, the fiancé turned around expressionlessly. There stood a girl of similar height to the fiancé. According to Sakura-chan, she had blonde twin-tails… But that detail is irrelevant. No doubt, just an ugly little pig. …Calling a stranger a pig is impolite. Let’s just call her a brat instead. Anyway, the brat approached the fiancé and Sakura-chan with a high-handed attitude. However, something about this is odd.
What does “Bouko” mean? When asked how it was written, the answer was “亡子.” It seems to be some kind of coined term, but I have no idea what it means.
“A worthless, foolish descendant like you, a ‘Bouko,’ has no right to act all carefree like this.”

The fiancé simply remained silent… looking at the brat with completely detached eyes. It was neither contempt nor interest. Feigning indifference can be troublesome, so they just quietly listened to the brat’s ranting without reaction—a truly mature response. The fiancé is the younger sister of the crimson swine. They are probably used to this kind of treatment because of everything they’ve endured from their older sister. That being said, since this is the courtyard of Faubrey, soldiers and castle staff occasionally pass by. At first, they seemed to think it was just children playing and watched from a distance.
“Who?”
Sakura-chan pointed at the rude little brat and asked the fiancé.

“You don’t need to know, Sakura-chan. Hmm… let’s see… that person is supposedly someone of great importance, as if they sit atop the clouds. Pardon me, but I’m busy keeping these children and their friends company, so I’ll be taking my leave.”
The fiancé gave a slight bow and attempted to leave, but the brat, now visibly annoyed, stepped forward.
“Oh? Associating with such lowly country folk? Bouko, you truly are a foolish child, giving no thought to the affairs of the nation.”
Unlike the fiancé, who tried to brush it off and walk away, Sakura-chan turned back with an irritated expression and snapped back.
“Hey! Don’t talk bad about Mel-chan!”
“Sakura-chan!”

The fiancé tried to restrain Sakura-chan and leave, but the brat took this as an opportunity to smirk confidently. Just hearing this is irritating. Sakura-chan is such a kind child who deeply cares about her friends.
“Hmph… Level 40, huh? That’s more than I expected.”
The brat then cast an analysis spell on Sakura-chan.
“And you dare to oppose me with such a level? My level is 92! I could easily crush low-level nobodies like you!”
“That doesn’t matter! I won’t let you insult Mel-chan!”
“Oh dear, what is a clueless little country girl like you doing in a place like this?”
At this, the fiancé furrowed their brows in displeasure and spoke up.
“Is peeking at someone’s level without permission something a noble person does? It’s no different from a disgraceful act of spying.”
“What did you just say!?”
“Am I wrong? Looking at someone’s level without their consent is hardly praiseworthy. If you don’t act in a way befitting your lineage, you won’t have the right to call yourself noble.”
“Hmph… associating with low-level trash like that will only bring you trouble.”
Hearing those words, Sakura-chan’s face lit up with understanding.
“Mel-chan, Sakura knows!”
“W-What is it, Sakura-chan?”

“Naofumi and the others told me. In this world, there are lots of good people, but there are also lots of bad people, so you have to be careful. But the ones you have to watch out for the most are the people who look down on others and try to insult them just because of their appearance or status.”Hmm, now that I think about it, I do recall having a conversation like that.

Father and the others were somewhat distrustful of people for a time because of the whole incident with the crimson swine and Trash. Moreover, since they had recently witnessed the dark side of Melromarc, they had been warning Sakura-chan and the others not to trust strangers unconditionally.
“Are you saying that applies to me!?”
“Uh—”
“Wow! Sakura-chan, you’re so knowledgeable!”

Just as Sakura-chan was about to respond with an enthusiastic “Yes!”, the fiancé cut her off. Apparently, Sakura-chan had her mouth covered, mumbling something incoherent. The fiancé then tried to steer the conversation away, saying:
“People like that sound scary. But you’re different, aren’t you?”
“Of course! I am bestowing wisdom upon the lowly.”
“…I see.”

“I’ll educate you as well. In this world, there are those who are chosen and those who are not. The strong are permitted to do whatever they please. On the other hand, for the weak… being weak itself is a sin. You two are both weak, which is why I look down on you. Do you understand?”
“That’s such an outdated way of thinking… Level is important, sure, but…”

The fiancé gave the brat a look of disbelief, bordering on contempt. This time, I have to agree with the fiancé. No matter how high you raise your level, if that’s all you rely on, it’s meaningless. In that regard, Sakura-chan and the others, who have managed to handle things with just Level 40, are quite capable. Now that I think about it, Ren once said something similar back in the first world and during a previous loop. Something like, “In this world, you can manage as long as you just level up.” And that mindset led to his failure. Judging from how Ren is now, it’s clear that just having a high level alone won’t get you anywhere. Perhaps sensing the fiancé’s exasperation, Sakura-chan added:
“Eh~ but Naofumi and the others said that strength isn’t measured by Level alone!”
“That’s just the excuse of the weak. The more pathetic someone is, the louder they bark. You and your little friend are both weak.”

Sakura-chan is absolutely right. Even if you raise your level to 100 or 200, if you don’t have the skill to back it up, it’s all pointless. I know what Father was like in the first world. For example, what we call an Energy Boost, Father managed to learn and master entirely on his own. It was a tricky technique where any poorly executed projectile would end up rebounding back at the user. If I recall correctly, Father referred to it as “Ki.” And yet, this brat can so casually mock someone they don’t even know. Father mentioned that she’s connected to Takt, but really, what a hopeless case.
“Ugh! Naofumi isn’t weak!”
“Don’t let it bother you, Sakura-chan. Come on, let’s continue our game of hide-and-seek. Kou-kun and Yuki-chan are waiting for you to come find them.”
The fiancé tried to soothe Sakura-chan with a gentle smile, but it seemed that only irritated the brat even more. Glaring at the fiancé and the others, she declared:
“If you have complaints, then defeat me first! Let’s begin the match!”
She then began chanting a spell, drawing a small sword from the scabbard at her waist as she approached.
“A duel without consent!?”
The fiancé’s eyes widened in shock.
Isn’t that less of a duel and more of an outright assault?
“Mel-chan, look out!”
“I’ll take you on with your own favored attribute! Zweit Aqua Shot!”
A rapidly cast spell flew toward the fiancé and Sakura-chan. Sakura-chan instantly transformed into her Filolial form and kicked the spell away.
“What do you think you’re doing all of a sudden!?”
“What is this creature? It looks like one of my brother’s… but I can’t forgive it for interfering with my magic!”

Brandishing her small sword, the brat lunged at Sakura-chan. Being Level 92, her movements appeared incredibly fast to the low-level fiancé. For the record, the reason the fiancé remains at a low level is to learn techniques and strategies that wouldn’t be necessary at higher levels—something I recall hearing in a previous loop. That’s why they deliberately keep their level low to develop ingenuity. Not mentioning this is likely to avoid unnecessary conflict. After all, despite their low level, the fiancé is quite capable of using high-level magic. Anyone who underestimates them based on level alone is bound to regret it. Even back in the first world, I remember they were surprisingly skilled in combat despite their stat values. In the previous loop, they demonstrated not only their proficiency in magic but also clever battle tactics—quietly, yet effectively proving their worth. As expected of the one chosen to be Filo-tan’s fiancé.
“…Enough of this.”
The fiancé, eyes filled with disdain, took a stance to cast magic. As expected of someone chosen by Filo-tan.
“I can tolerate it if it’s just me, and I can deflect it. But don’t drag Sakura-chan into this!”
